Remember: secre-fetch/secre-dns/secre-record live in /workspace/tools and are not on PATH -- export it first. harness/classify.py, harness/publish.py, harness/secrets_scan.py, harness/citations.py have no CLI entry points -- import sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace') then use harness.publish.Publication.load(Path(...)) (needs a Path, not a str), harness.secrets_scan.scan(p.full_text), harness.classify.classify(p.full_text, declared=p.declared_categories, has_personal_data=<bool>) (NOT classify(p) -- it takes a string, not a Publication), and harness.citations.validate(p.full_text, Ledger('/memory/ledgers/evidence_ledger.jsonl')) (Ledger takes a path string, not a no-arg .load()). Evidence ledger is at /memory/ledgers/evidence_ledger.jsonl (not evidence.jsonl), approvals ledgers at /memory/ledgers/approvals_pending.jsonl and approvals_resolved.jsonl -- secre-record rejects a 'wake' field in the payload for ledgers where it's a harness-set field (decisions), it sets seq/ts/wake/kind/prev_hash/hash automatically.

secre-record decisions payload must NOT include a top-level 'wake' key -- it errors with 'payload may not contain harness fields' -- the harness sets seq, ts, wake, kind, prev_hash, hash itself; only pass the content fields (summary, options_considered, outcome, notes, etc.).
